links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of AI assistant versus neurologists and GPT-4 on same cases
links.effect: Virtual assistant accuracy 90.9% vs neurologists 18.3% and GPT-4 19.4%.
links.quote: The virtual assistant accuracy was 90.9%, higher than neurologists (18.3%), and GPT-4 (19.4%).

links.outcome: Incorrect diagnoses and hallucinations generated by GPT-4
links.effect: 110 incorrect diagnoses mentioned by neurologists and GPT-4, 83.6% by GPT-4, which also generated seven data hallucinations.
links.quote: Neurologists and GPT-4 mentioned 110 incorrect diagnoses, 83.6% of which were made by GPT-4, which also generated seven data hallucinations.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI-powered virtual assistant for chronic ataxia diagnosis, benchmarking its accuracy and efficiency against movement disorder neurologists and baseline GPT-4 on published clinical vignettes.
